scope: CIFAR-10 direct/TET six-timestep VGG-9 greatest-excess non-winner regularization calibration

recipe.dynamics: beta=0.5, ATan surrogate, immediate reset, AdamW cosine schedule, norm-5 gradient clipping

reference.note: The lambda=0 reference pre-dated non-winner telemetry, so its non-winner rate was not recorded.

conclusion: All four one-seed runs completed with active deep and output layers. Increasing lambda monotonically reduced recorded non-winner firing (0.7907% at lambda=0.03 to 0.3634% at lambda=1.0), but accuracy fell from 88.04% to 84.48%. Lambda=0.1 matched the unregularized same-seed accuracy within 0.02 percentage points (88.26% vs 88.28%) while recording a 0.7151% non-winner firing rate. A zero-lambda telemetry reference is needed before claiming an absolute sparsity reduction; stronger fixed penalties are not suitable for expansion. If stronger regularization is pursued, test a warm-up/ramp schedule rather than applying it from epoch 1.
